mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sql_optimization_history (original_sql, optimized_sql, optimization_level, include_index_suggestion, optimization_suggestions, problems, estimated_improvement, execution_time, source, created_at) VALUES (#{originalSql}, #{optimizedSql}, #{optimizationLevel}, #{includeIndexSuggestion}, #{optimizationSuggestions}, #{problems}, #{estimatedImprovement}, #{executionTime}, #{source}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sql_optimization_history ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
